label: Custody / warehouse possession
description: Whether the goods were legally/factually in marketplace custody at the relevant time

label: Quantity
description: How many units were proven to be present/lost

label: Valuation basis
description: Which valuation basis is legally/evidentially accepted

label: Cost of goods
description: Purchase/manufacturing cost and its proof

label: Lost profit
description: Whether lost profit was claimed and sufficiently proven

label: Causation
description: Causal link between breach/event and claimed loss

label: Contract scope
description: Which contractual terms govern the relevant goods/relationship

label: Force majeure
description: Application of force-majeure rules/contract clauses

label: Retroactivity
description: Whether later contractual terms apply to earlier-transferred inventory

label: Limitation of liability
description: Validity/scope of contractual liability limitations

label: Set-off / deductions
description: Whether marketplace deductions or offsets are permissible

label: Retail-price valuation
description: Values lost inventory using retail/site selling price

label: COGS valuation
description: Values lost inventory using purchase/manufacturing cost

label: Dynamic marketplace valuation
description: Uses turnover/discount/SPP or marketplace dynamic-price logic

label: Storage/bailment qualification
description: Argues duties analogous to storage/bailment under applicable civil-law rules

label: Force-majeure position
description: Invokes or contests force majeure

label: Retroactivity position
description: Invokes or contests application of changed offer terms to earlier inventory

label: Marketplace deductions
description: Defendant relies on contractual/calculation deductions

label: No transfer / custody denial
description: Defendant argues goods were not received/present

label: Historical-sales lost profit
description: Uses sales history/velocity/margin to support lost profit

label: Marketplace admission reliance
description: Relies on marketplace-generated inventory/compensation records as admissions

label: Expert examination request
description: Requests court/independent expertise on loss or valuation

label: Marketplace report
description: Marketplace-generated stock/compensation/nomenclature report

label: Acceptance act
description: Formal warehouse/fulfillment acceptance record

label: Transport document
description: Waybill/TTN/shipping proof

label: Supplier UPD
description: Universal transfer document or supplier invoice evidence

label: Customs declaration
description: Import/customs documentation supporting quantity/cost

label: Seller ERP data
description: 1C/MoySklad or equivalent seller system records

label: Expert/valuer report
description: Completed expert or valuation report; distinguish from requested expertise

label: Fire/emergency authority act
description: Official fire/emergency/incident documentation

label: Bank/payment evidence
description: Payment records supporting acquisition cost
